title: Broken Umbrella
lesson: Air service slots, replacement homes and paid repair.

objectives.text: Lose all HQs, production structures and engineering rigs.
Keep at least one airfield operational through twelve minutes.
Evacuate both marked aircraft to the backup site, service each and repair battle damage on the wing.

markers.text: Backup airfield and wing evacuation area

scenario_exceptions.detail: Finite scripted enemy column 1: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (100,52).
Finite scripted enemy column 2: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (83,20).
Finite scripted enemy column 3: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (100,52).
Finite scripted enemy column 4: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (83,20).

All mission starting assets are listed in the opening state. Allied recovery transfers existing actors and preserves caps. Scripted enemy columns are finite, announced scenario exceptions; they are not paid AI production.

subtitles.speaker: Commander Mara Vale
subtitles.text: Two airfields are exposed. Keep at least one operational until twelve minutes have elapsed. Shift service assignments and protect power. Evacuate the marked wing to the backup site after it has needed paid repairs and has completed service.

subtitles.speaker: Operations
subtitles.text: Air service slots, replacement homes and paid repair.

subtitles.speaker: Operations
subtitles.text: Halfway through the pressure window. Reassign homes before an airfield is lost.

subtitles.speaker: Commander Mara Vale
subtitles.text: Broken Umbrella is complete. Keep the route secure; the next operation will depend on what we learned here.

subtitles.speaker: Commander Mara Vale
subtitles.text: We can no longer meet this operation’s requirements. Return to the last checkpoint and change the approach.
